init_msn_loss: create an unsupervised MSN loss function with configurable temperature, me-max regularization, and anchor views
loss_snn_predictions: compute soft nearest neighbours similarity predictions between anchor views and prototypes using cosine similarity
loss_sharpen_targets: sharpen target predictions by raising probabilities to a temperature power and normalizing across classes
loss_me_max_regularizer: compute the me-max regularizer loss by calculating the entropy of averaged prototype probabilities
distributed_sinkhorn: normalize a prototype assignment matrix using the distributed Sinkhorn-Knopp algorithm across multiple GPUs
